title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.17968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks from the aortic annulus to the bifurcation on any CT image, following current guideline recommendations.   Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 239 arterial phase CT angiography examinations of 230 patients (median age, 65 years [range, 18-99 years]; 163 men) performed between April 2025 and October 2026 (209 electrocardiographically [ECG] gated). The tool locates landmarks from TotalSegmentator segmentations of aortic branches and vertebrae and measures the maximum diameter at each. A senior radiologist reviewed and, where needed, corrected the automated measurements to create the reference standard. translated_abstract: 目的：开发并评估一种全自动、开源的工具，该工具遵循当前指南推荐，可在任何CT图像上从主动脉瓣环到髂动脉分叉处的11个标准化解剖标志点测量主动脉直径。材料与方法：这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了2025年4月至2026年10月间230名患者的239次动脉期CT血管造影检查（中位年龄65岁[范围18-99岁]；男性163名）（其中209次为心电图门控）。该工具基于TotalSegmentator对主动脉分支和椎体的分割结果定位解剖标志点，并测量每个标志点处的最大直径。由一名资深放射科医师审核并在需要时校正自动测量结果，以建立参考标准。一致性通过平均绝对误差（MAE）、偏倚以及大于2mm的测量差异进行评估。结果：在所有标志点处，MAE为1.06 mm（95% CI: 0.91, 1.22），86.6%的[摘要内容在此处截断]
tldr: 该研究开发并验证了一种全自动开源工具，可在CT图像上遵循指南推荐的11个标准化解剖标志点自动测量主动脉直径，与人工参考标准的平均绝对误差仅为1.06毫米。
en_tdlr: This study developed and validated a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 guideline-recommended standardized landmarks on CT images, achieving a mean absolute error of only 1.06 mm against the radiologist reference standard.
